issues.finding: Segment assets less liabilities is not certified standalone financial equity. Consolidated eliminations and Forestar minority economic claims remain unallocated.

issues.finding: September cash/debt/share base is adjusted only for October $600m maturity and assumed dilution/reserve. $34.6m unsettled repurchases are not separately adjusted. Forestar excess-cash transferability is unverified.
